$comment: Schema and examples for all sprint log JSON files under docs/sprint-logs/{SprintID}/. Realigned in Se173ef (2026-07-06) to the CURRENT artifact set actually written by the sprint/autopilot skills, so the Palmux Sprint tab (internal/tab/sprint) stays in sync and does not drift again. The canonical trust-source files are verify-run.json (machine verdict) and verification-report.json (independent verifier); done-judgment.json / compromises.json / comprehension-report.md / prototype-review.json / reopen.json capture the 6-guard judgment, notify-after concessions, milestone narrative, prototype approval, and re-open history respectively.

$artifact_index.$comment: Authoritative list of what lives under docs/sprint-logs/{SprintID}/. The Sprint tab backend reads these exact names — keep this list and the tab's readers (internal/tab/sprint/handler.go + parser/artifacts.go) in lockstep. When a new artifact is introduced: (1) add it here, (2) add a parser + reader in the tab, (3) surface it in the tab UI. See docs/sprint-logs/README.md in the palmux2 repo for the tab⇄skill contract.

deprecated.acceptance-matrix.json: REMOVED. AC pass/fail is now derived from verification-report.json ac_findings + ROADMAP.json acceptance_criteria[].status. The Sprint tab reads it only for very old sprints that still carry the file.
deprecated.e2e-results.json: REMOVED. Per-run test results now come from verify-run.json (machine verdict, backed by real exit codes). The Sprint tab reads it only for very old sprints that still carry the file.
deprecated.refine.json: LEGACY. Interactive refine records; still written by `sprint refine` when a human refines UI/UX, but no longer surfaced as a dedicated tab (Se173ef folded the IA to Overview/Detail/Review/Milestones/Decisions). Read for backward compatibility.

$artifact_index.note_on_verification_results: verification-results.json is STILL written by `sprint verify` (model-authored AC↔test traceability + diff_coverage). It is NOT the machine trust source — verify-run.json is (its status values are copied from verify-run.json per test-discipline Rule 9). The Sprint tab reads verify-run.json + verification-report.json for the machine/verifier verdicts, not verification-results.json.

decisions.$comment: Autonomous decisions made during the sprint. adr_ref links the decision to a load-bearing ADR when applicable.

decisions.title: Short decision title
decisions.adr_ref: ADR-0003 (or null if no relevant ADR)

verify_run.$comment: MACHINE-AUTHORED test verdict, written by hooks/run-verify.py from real process exit codes (+ JUnit when present). This is the trust source for test status: sprint done's gate and the verification-integrity hook read this, NOT the model's verification-results.json. Models MUST NOT edit it. Each run also appends `__VERIFY_EXIT_CODE__:{name}:{code}` to the tail of verify-run-{name}.log for tamper-evidence. Full schema: references/VERIFY_RUN_SCHEMA.json.

verification_report.$comment: Output of the INDEPENDENT verifier sub-agent (sprint verify --with-verifier; always under autopilot --auto). A separate read-only session re-checks AC↔code, the forbidden-category scan, ADR conformance, and compromise completeness. Where it disagrees with the implementer's self-report the verifier wins; missed items get overlooked_by_autopilot: true. Full schema: references/VERIFICATION_REPORT_SCHEMA.json.

ac_findings.evidence: file:line references proving the AC is met against real code, not just a green test name

done_judgment.$comment: Per-Story 6(-8) guard done judgment (references/sprint-done-judgment.md). Any story with overall != 'ok' is held at needs_user_review, not done. Guard keys are conventionally guard_{N}_{name}; each value begins with the verdict token (pass/fail/warn/n/a) followed by the evaluation sentence. The Sprint tab parses the leading token as the guard status and the whole string as the hover detail.

Sb1e4d8-1.guard_1_not_user_review_required: pass — roadmap did not pre-mark this needs_user_review
Sb1e4d8-1.guard_2_nil_injection_mock: pass — real dependency exercised in acceptance test
Sb1e4d8-1.guard_5_call_path: pass — end-to-end call path grep-present and exercised
Sb1e4d8-1.guard_6_deferral_comments: pass — no deferred TODO/Phase-N comments in the diff

compromises.$comment: The notify-after-completion concessions autopilot made and continued past (§2.4). Written at a milestone boundary. Immediate-stop categories (acceptance_criteria_modified, destructive git, ADR violation) never reach this file. Real files put the arrays at the top level; the historical schema example nested them under milestone_summary{} — the Sprint tab accepts both. Full schema: autopilot/references/COMPROMISES_SCHEMA.json.

comprehension_report.$comment: Markdown (NOT JSON) — the milestone narrative: 'what changed / why this way / what to verify / what was assumed'. Written at a milestone boundary immediately after compromises.json. Read this before `autopilot review`. The Sprint tab renders it as Markdown and extracts the ## / ### headings as a table of contents. Template: autopilot/references/comprehension-report-template.md.

prototype_review.$comment: Approved GUI prototype screens + design decisions from `sprint prototype`. The Sprint tab shows the approved screens, feedback rounds, and design decisions alongside the gui-spec state diagram.
design_decisions: Short design decision statements the user approved

reopen.$comment: Written when a previously-done Story/Sprint is re-opened (autopilot Review Mode ① AC-violation, or an explicit user manual_retroactive request). Records why + when so the 'a done Sprint became in_progress again' history is auditable. A single object (not an array). Full schema: references/REOPEN_SCHEMA.json.

verification_results.$comment: MODEL-AUTHORED test execution + AC↔test traceability + diff_coverage (Rule 6). Its per-test status values are COPIED from verify-run.json (the machine verdict) — the model authors only `evidence`, never the verdict (test-discipline Rule 9). NOT the machine trust source; the Sprint tab reads verify-run.json/verification-report.json for the machine/verifier verdicts. Still written by every `sprint verify`.

tests.name: [AC-Sb1e4d8-1-1] should display VM list after login

diff_coverage.$comment: Rule 6 — user-observable additions in this Sprint's diff and how each is covered. resolution ∈ covered | added_test | reverted | needs_human.

surfaces.test: [AC-Sb1e4d8-1-1] should display VM list after login

done_judgment.$comment: Optional mirror of the per-Story 6-guard outcome (also written standalone to done-judgment.json). overall: 'needs_user_review' blocks sprint done for that Story.

refine.$comment: LEGACY. Interactive refinement changes from user feedback (`sprint refine`). Read for backward compatibility; no longer a dedicated Sprint tab.

attempts.result: Production LDAP has custom schema not replicable

scenario.$comment: User scenario for a non-GUI Story (CLI, API, library). GUI Stories use gui-spec-{StoryID}.json instead. See sprint/references/story-scenarios.md for the full taxonomy and rules.
scenario.user_role: operator running deploys from their laptop

scenarios.description: Operator starts a stopped VM and confirms it is running
preconditions: A VM named vm-123 exists in stopped state

gui_spec.$comment: GUI specification for a Story — state diagram + endpoint contracts + data_testids. The Sprint tab renders state_diagram as Mermaid.
gui_spec.state_diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Empty: page load (no data)
    Empty --> Loading: user clicks Add
    Loading --> Populated: API success
    Loading --> Error: API failure
